symptom: MDL-AGENT02 (agent without SelectedModel) and MDL-AGENT03 (consumed MCP service without Endpoint) never fired for `create or modify`, the form project scripts and describe use to create a document, so a new agent or service written that way passed check, check --references and exec silently; and lint flagged no stored document without either.
file: mdl/executor/validate_agent_left_unset.go (warnAgentDocumentsLeftUnset, agentEditorReadsSelectedModel), wired in validate.go validateProgramWithWarnings (check --references and exec preflight); mdl/linter/rules/agent_documents.go (MPR014 AgentWithoutSelectedModel, MPR015 ConsumedMCPServiceWithoutEndpoint), mdl/linter/context_catalog_tables.go (Agents, ConsumedMCPServices, MarketplaceModuleVersion), registered in cmd/mxcli/cmd_lint.go and mdl/executor/cmd_lint.go. Tests: validate_agent_left_unset_test.go, rules/agent_documents_test.go
cause: The static rules skipped every create or modify because a key it leaves out keeps the stored value; a static rule cannot see whether a value is stored, so the skip also covered a new document, which has nothing to keep.
insight: **A rule that exempts `create or modify` because it 'keeps the stored value' needs a project-aware half, or it exempts the most common way to create.** The static pass cannot distinguish new from existing; the reference pass (validateProgramWithWarnings, shared by check --references and exec) can, replaying drops, creates and alters in statement order over the stored documents. The selected-model half is version-gated: AgentEditorCommons 1.1.0 does not read selectedModel, and FactoryManagement's agents (1.1.0) have none, so an ungated rule would flag every agent of a working app. MPR014 on a scratch ICXGraphPilot copy flagged an agent that the original has a selected model for: that copy had been through a pre-#2031 describe/exec, which drops it; a fresh copy lints clean. Controls: stubbing the pass, removing either version gate, and an empty ConsumedMCPServices accessor each fail their test; a build without the change passes the issue's script with `Check passed!` and no warning.
